newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close mixed, focus on bank sale.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close mixed, focus on bank sale.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed Thursday as investor interest focused on the afternoon auction of the country's seventh largest bank conducted simultaneously through the Bogota, Medellin and Cali exchanges.

Bogota's IBB general index drifted 0.11 percent lower to 829.62 on volume of 652 million pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index edged up 0.08 percent to 13,180.95 on 1.18 billion peso volume.
As general apathy pervaded trading as all eyes turned to the 80 percent stake -- to be sold as one lot -- in Banco Popular, scheduled to go under the gavel in the afternoon.
